svg.title: UML Diagram: Class PhysicalMapping in Context

g.text: UML Diagram: Class PhysicalMapping in Context
- The arrows of the inheritance tree are

a.title: • ControlledVocabularyEntry: Allows for unstructured content which may be an entry from an externally maintained controlled vocabulary.If the content is from a controlled vocabulary provide the code value of the entry, as well as a reference to the controlled vocabulary from which the value is taken. Provide as many of the iden ...
a.xlink:title: • ControlledVocabularyEntry: Allows for unstructured content which may be an entry from an externally maintained controlled vocabulary.If the content is from a controlled vocabulary provide the code value of the entry, as well as a reference to the controlled vocabulary from which the value is taken. Provide as many of the iden ...

a.title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.
a.xlink:title: • Identifier: Identifier for objects requiring short- or long-lasting referencing and management.

a.title: • PhysicalDataSet: Information needed for understanding the physical structure of data coming from a file or other source.
a.xlink:title: • PhysicalDataSet: Information needed for understanding the physical structure of data coming from a file or other source.

a.title: • PhysicalMappingPosition: Denotes the position of a physical mapping in a sequence within a physical data set.
a.xlink:title: • PhysicalMappingPosition: Denotes the position of a physical mapping in a sequence within a physical data set.

a.title: • InstanceVariable: Use of a represented variable within a data set.
a.xlink:title: • InstanceVariable: Use of a represented variable within a data set.

a.title: • IndividualMember: Distinct element that is not itself a collection (atomic).
a.xlink:title: • IndividualMember: Distinct element that is not itself a collection (atomic).

a.title: • Member: Element in a collection that can be either atomic (individual member) or composite (collection).
a.xlink:title: • Member: Element in a collection that can be either atomic (individual member) or composite (collection).

a.title: • TextMapping: The physical characteristics of an instance variable which appears in a data set using a text-based encoding and having a tabular structure (a tabular text data set).
a.xlink:title: • TextMapping: The physical characteristics of an instance variable which appears in a data set using a text-based encoding and having a tabular structure (a tabular text data set).

a.title: • LocatorMapping: The physical characteristics of an instance variable which appears in a data set using a binary or highly structured text-based encoding (a structured data set).
a.xlink:title: • LocatorMapping: The physical characteristics of an instance variable which appears in a data set using a binary or highly structured text-based encoding (a structured data set).

a.title: • indexes: Assigns a position to a value mapping within a physical segment.
a.xlink:title: • indexes: Assigns a position to a value mapping within a physical segment.
